'''Canni''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] living during the [[war against Zakuul]]. Some time after the [[War on Iokath]] he and [[Umbaran Shadow Assassin]] [[Elli-Vaa]] were protecting a [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertrain]] with a large supply of [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystals]] heading for the [[Umbaran capital city/Legends|Umbara capital city]]. The train was [[Crisis on Umbara|attacked]] by the [[Eternal Alliance]] [[Alliance Commander|Commander]], [[Theron Shan]] and [[Lana Beniko]], who attempted to intercept the shipment. Canni and Elli-Vaa attempted to stop them, but were defeated and killed.

==Behind the scenes==
Technician Canni appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' expansion as a boss during the Umbara flashpoint.
